usedFor: Sellsy holds the invoices, tasks and opportunities, TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, and “Invoice Created” can start “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoice Created” in Sellsy, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new invoice in Sellsy runs a command on your computers.

watchOut: “Deleted Task” also reaches “Trigger Command”, so a command can run when a task is removed.
